description: This header defines interfaces for console I/O operations in a firmware project, including function prototypes, macros, and type definitions related to console communication and command handling.

methods.name: getConsoleChannel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the BaseChannel used for console communication.

methods.name: consolePutChar
methods.description: Outputs a single character to the console.

methods.name: consoleOutputBuffer
methods.description: Outputs a buffer of data to the console.

methods.name: startConsole
methods.description: Initializes and starts the console system with provided logger and command handler.

methods.name: isCommandLineConsoleOverTTL
methods.description: Checks if the command line console communication is over TTL.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Handler called when data arrives on the console interface.

methods.name: isCommandLineConsoleReady
methods.description: Checks if the command line console is ready to accept commands.
